ctx.x: How big is your body of work – compositions?

Uh, I'd have to research that one. It's not small though. I mean uh, it's not, there are people who have done more, of course. I'm not up with Ellington with the two thousand plus compositions recorded, but I might be up to two hundred, which is uh, I'll settle for that for the moment. But uh, that's a good question. I saw uh a list of uh my works in the program of the Playboy Jazz Festival just uh – what month was that? – either August or September. And it just happened to show uh, uh, uh, my stuff took up a…
How important is it to you to be recognized as a composer?
